description: Fetch one IDB procurement notice by its notice id (from idb_search_notices results). Returns the full record: project, loan number, sector, procurement method, publication date, deadline, and the document URL on idbdocs.iadb.org. If the id has multiple entries (amendments/re-publications), all are returned newest-first.

notice_id.description: IDB notice id, e.g. "38846" — find ids via idb_search_notices.

name: idb_get_notice
title: Idb Get Notice
